summary: 靠测量解决游戏帧率问题：先分清 CPU 还是 GPU 瓶颈，再做收益最大的修复（绘制调用、对象池、GC 尖峰）。 Finds and fixes game frame-rate problems by measurement in Godot, Unity, Unreal or Roblox: CPU- vs GPU-bound, then the biggest fix (draw calls, pooling, GC spikes). Use for low FPS, stutter, a first-use hitch, or requests to optimize or profile. Not for build size (`unity-build-size`), physics jitter (`physics-tuning`) or network lag (`roblox-networking`, `godot-multiplayer`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill performance-optimization，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for low FPS, stutter, a first-use hitch, or requests to optimize or profile.
Follow its sections: Core workflow; Patterns; Gotchas; Related skills.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：physics-tuning 用 gene_gdsk_physics_tuning_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
